title: Review-check workflow: pin devcontainer image to new digest
summary: A one-line repin of the container image the review-check workflow runs in. The REVIEW_IMAGE env var now points at the manifest-list digest built from commit 373b26c0 instead of e40b471d, so every job that consumes that image (the codex review job and its version check) picks up the newer devcontainer build. No job structure, trigger or step logic changes; only the pinned artifact identity moves.
